info.title: Substrate AI - Vagus Engine
info.description: The emotional chromosome of AI. Vagal tone changes how truth is delivered. Never whether.

post.description: Try it on yourself: a sandboxed genome in any tissue, open without a key, never mixed with client data.

Stateless bet arithmetic: price to probability, parlay legs, round robins, fees, Kelly, bankroll share.
No genome, no personal data. For platforms that want an honest pre-bet panel.

Stateless FX and gold volatility: GARCH/EWMA, ranges, stop-out odds, event combinatorics, trader biases.
Direction is never forecast.

get.description: Live price for a Polymarket market slug via the public Gamma API (best effort).

post.description: Create a shareable test link. Admin/master key once the deployment is locked down.
Each invitee gets a private sandboxed genome in the invite's tissue, seeded from the demo profile.
Seal a letter for an heir. It opens on a date, an age, or the moment they need it.

get.description: Letters to this person (sealed ones show only title and release) and letters they have written.
The genome as plain-language memories (Mem0, Letta, any agent memory) plus a Letta-style core block.

post.description: The human makes a promise to their future self. Substrate holds them to it, kindly.

delete.description: Release is always allowed, and always recorded.

post.description: OpenAI-compatible harness. Point any OpenAI SDK's base_url at Substrate.

get.description: OpenAI-style model list so SDKs and tools can discover the harness.

post.description: Pass a genome down: the heir receives the elder's values and the lessons they paid for (per consent).

get.description: What the next training round would learn from (consented public genomes + self-distillation).
Impact: honest pauses, honest-choice rate, money protected vs cost of ignoring, top patterns, risky hours.
Printable, regulator-ready audit of one person's advice record with live hash-chain verification.
Follow-ups Substrate owes this person: the morning after, what did you decide, you kept your word.
The Advisor Desk: people who need a human, most urgent first. Crisis words are never included.

post.description: Meta delivers messages here. Signature-verified; each sender gets a private hashed genome.
Dry-run the WhatsApp channel without Meta: returns exactly what would be sent.

put.description: Register this tenant's webhook. The signing secret is shown once.

post.description: Create a publishable key (pk_live_...) for the browser SDK, locked to your origins. Tenant key required.
The browser SDK's single call: the honest pause before a click.
Closes the loop from the widget: Cancel means followed, Proceed anyway means ignored.
